description: Readable text of the page (PDFs too), main content first, lists and tables kept as lists and rows, secrets masked, without refs. url opens that page first and reads it in the same call: use it for a page you will only read. A long page comes in parts: the reply says where the rest starts (offset). mode links lists only the links. To read a few values or a list, browser_query is far smaller.

max_chars.description: Default 8000. A longer page says where the rest starts.

mode.description: links: only the page's links, one a line

offset.description: Read on from this character, as the last read said

selector.description: CSS selector: only the first match's text, e.g. "main" or "#results"

url.description: Open this http(s) URL first and read it, in one call

name: browser_get_text
title: Page text
